spec.claim_rule: A contrast (A,B) is SUPPORTED for a claim-eligible family only if, in EVERY split and at EVERY density of that family, it is Holm-significant at parent level in the claimed direction AND the layout-level cluster-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction (needs >= 5 layouts). EQUIVALENT only if the 95% CI of the relative RMSE difference lies inside +/- margin in every cell (needs >= 8 parents). Anything else is NOT SUPPORTED.
claims: H6 (primary): kgnn_prior has lower RMSE than kgnn
H7 (primary): kgnn_prior_sk has lower RMSE than rk_side
Secondary: every contrast in contrasts_krig / contrasts_side2
Nothing else is tested confirmatorily; any other contrast is exploratory and labelled so.
designed_after_seeing: the whole idea (meta-learned kernel prior, propagation-aware kernel, ensembles, GB baseline) follows rounds 1-2
the 2% equivalence margin and minimum-n rules are inherited from round 2

fresh.dm_path: NOT fresh units; descriptive only; no prior (one environment per scenario)
fresh.sod: APs not used in round 2, seed 3
fresh.uji: APs not used in rounds 1-2, seed 3

spec.holm: one family per (dataset, split, contrast list); cap = contrasts x densities x inference scenarios

prior.pooled_real_prior: UJI and SOD buildings are pooled: a held-out building is predicted by a prior trained on the other 5

spec.title: radio-map extension, round 3: meta-learned kriging-attention prior, side-aware kernel, GB baseline
spec.tuning: none: library defaults (Kmax=12, s2_init=0.3). The prior is trained on OTHER layouts only; no hyper-parameter is chosen on any evaluation unit.

wording_rule.EQUIVALENT: the paper must say A matches B within the margin
wording_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: the paper must say the advantage was not established; per-cell wins may be shown but not called confirmed
wording_rule.SUPPORTED_A_better: the paper may state that A improves on B on this family, with the per-density effect sizes and the layout-level CI
wording_rule.SUPPORTED_A_worse: the paper must report that A is worse
